title: The Licence and the Shared Name

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Track which instrument grants technical permission and which governs representation under the shared name.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A departing team could keep developing released open-source code while ceasing official mark use.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Licence and the Shared Name offers an argument about cooperation beyond a single licence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to question how openness and responsibility might remain compatible as institutions grow.
